title: Cross Site Scripting (XSS) in Group.jsp in Apache JSPWIKI on versions older than 2.12.5 allows attacker to execute…
description: A Cross Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the Group.jsp component of Apache JSPWIKI versions older than 2.12.5. This flaw allows an attacker to execute arbitrary JavaScript via a specially crafted URL. The issue is resolved in version 2.12.5.
